name: Rent — Producción
description: Operación de backend NestJS, frontend Next.js y worker batch. Cuenta 8213841. Tráfico, latencia, errores y memoria de proceso.

rawConfiguration.text:
### Rent en producción
APM: [Backend](https://one.newrelic.com/redirect/entity/ODIxMzg0MXxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTQ4MjMwNDg2Ng) · [Frontend](https://one.newrelic.com/redirect/entity/ODIxMzg0MXxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTQ4MjMwMTM1Mg) · [Batch](https://one.newrelic.com/redirect/entity/ODIxMzg0MXxBUE18QVBQTElDQVRJT058MTQ4MjMwMTcxNA)

Período inicial: última hora; puede ajustarse con el selector de tiempo. El worker batch reporta métricas de proceso aunque no tenga transacciones. Frontend corresponde al servidor Next.js; no incluye monitoreo del navegador.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Transacciones' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT average(duration) * 1000 AS 'Latencia (ms)' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Errores (%)' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'Transacciones/min' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') FACET appName TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') FACET appName TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Errores (%)' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') FACET appName TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) AS 'Memoria (MB)' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName = 'Memory/Physical' AND appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') FACET appName TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) AS 'Memoria (MB)' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName = 'Memory/Physical' AND appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') FACET appName SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Cantidad', average(duration) * 1000 AS 'Latencia media (ms)' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('RENT-Backend-production', 'RENT-Frontend-production', 'RENT-Batch-production') FACET appName, name LIMIT 10 SINCE 1 hour ago
